'''Baryte''' is a [[Minerals#Geode Minerals|mineral]] that can be found in the [[Magma Geode]] and the [[Omni Geode]].

==Bundles==
Baryte is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Baryte is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Baryte is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt181.png|24px]] It can be also used as a red dye color at the dye pots in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Baryte is not used in any [[quests]].

==Trivia==
Desert roses in real life can also be gypsum.
